title: Boxer And Mixed Martial Artist Claressa Shields Wants To Join WWE One Day, 'Call Me Anytime' [Watch]
htmlContent:
Claressa Shields, the reigning boxing champion and a force to be reckoned with in combat sports, sent shockwaves through the sports industry when she expressed her interest in joining the glitz and glamour of WWE. During a captivating Scoop B Radio Podcast interview, Shields fearlessly declared, "The WWE can call me anytime.

“I will come in there with my half-shirt on. I will come in there with my little tight legging shorts on & I will definitely go on WWE & I will definitely;

LISTEN. I’m a natural entertainer. I believe that I would have a part in the storyline, and I would be all for it.”

Her words instantly captivated audiences and ignited a fervor of excitement and speculation about the potential crossover between boxing and professional wrestling.

Having garnered numerous accolades, including two Olympic gold medals and multiple world titles, Shields had established herself as a dominant force in the realm of boxing. However, her hunger for new challenges and a desire to captivate audiences in different ways led her to explore the world of sports entertainment. Shields' announcement on the podcast showcased her confidence, charisma, and willingness to push boundaries.

The mention of her iconic half shirt not only hinted at her unique sense of style but also symbolized her intent to bring her own brand of intensity to the WWE. Known for her fierce determination and unwavering dedication to her craft, Shields promised to leave no stone unturned when transitioning from the boxing ring to the wrestling arena.

The anticipation of potential dream matches against the WWE's finest became a hot topic of discussion. Imaginations ran wild as fans envisioned Shields stepping into the squared circle to face off against legendary WWE superstars or engaging in dramatic rivalries with other fierce competitors. The prospect of her bringing her trademark intensity and athleticism to the world of professional wrestling promised a captivating spectacle like no other.
